description: Build the public-facing website pages with Next.js 15 App Router: Landing page, Fleet listing, Fleet detail, About, Contact, FAQ, Partnership, and Blog pages. Implement mobile-first responsive design with the Karya Kreatif Andalan branding, Framer Motion animations, and SEO optimization.
steps: Create apps/web/src/lib/ utilities: utils.ts (cn helper), api.ts (axios/fetch wrapper with base URL config), constants.ts (brand colors, company info, nav links), fonts.ts (Google Fonts setup - Inter + Plus Jakarta Sans)

Create apps/web/src/components/layout/ with: Header.tsx (responsive navbar with mobile hamburger menu, logo, nav links, auth buttons), Footer.tsx (company info, links, social media, WhatsApp), MobileNav.tsx (slide-in mobile navigation with Sheet component), WhatsAppFloat.tsx (floating WhatsApp button fixed bottom-right)
Create apps/web/src/app/(public)/layout.tsx that wraps public pages with Header + Footer + WhatsAppFloat

Create apps/web/src/app/(public)/page.tsx - Landing Page with sections: HeroSection (gradient background, headline 'Solusi Kendaraan untuk Driver Online', search CTA, stats counters animated with Framer Motion), BenefitsSection (icon cards: penghasilan tinggi, kendaraan terawat, proses cepat, harga terjangkau), HowItWorksSection (step-by-step rental process with numbered timeline), PricingSection (pricing cards for different vehicle types), FleetShowcase (carousel of featured vehicles), TestimonialsSection (driver testimonials with avatars), FAQSection (accordion), CTASection (final call-to-action with gradient background)

Create apps/web/src/app/(public)/fleet/page.tsx - Fleet Listing with: search bar, filter sidebar (category, price range, transmission, availability), vehicle grid with cards showing image/name/price/specs/availability badge, pagination, loading skeletons, empty state. Use TanStack Query for data fetching with mock data initially.

Create apps/web/src/app/(public)/fleet/[id]/page.tsx - Fleet Detail with: image gallery (multiple photos with lightbox), vehicle specs table, rental pricing breakdown (daily/weekly/monthly), estimated earnings calculator for different platforms (Gojek/Grab/Maxim), availability calendar, terms and conditions accordion, booking CTA button, related vehicles section
Create apps/web/src/app/(public)/about/page.tsx - About page with: company story, mission/vision, team section, why drivers choose us stats, partner platforms (Gojek, Grab, Maxim, InDrive logos)
Create apps/web/src/app/(public)/contact/page.tsx - Contact page with: contact form (React Hook Form + Zod), WhatsApp direct link, office address with embedded map placeholder, operating hours
Create apps/web/src/app/(public)/faq/page.tsx - FAQ page with categorized accordion (Pendaftaran, Pembayaran, Kendaraan, Pengembalian)
Create apps/web/src/app/(public)/partnership/page.tsx - Partnership page for fleet investors: benefits, ROI calculator, partnership form
Create apps/web/src/app/(public)/blog/page.tsx and apps/web/src/app/(public)/blog/[slug]/page.tsx - Blog listing and detail with SEO-optimized layout, categories, mock blog posts about driver tips

Create apps/web/src/components/shared/ reusable components: VehicleCard.tsx, SectionTitle.tsx, StatsCounter.tsx (animated number counter), TestimonialCard.tsx, PricingCard.tsx, SearchBar.tsx, FilterPanel.tsx, EmptyState.tsx, LoadingSkeleton.tsx
Implement SEO: metadata in each page, OpenGraph tags, JSON-LD structured data for LocalBusiness and Product schemas, generateMetadata for dynamic pages
Add Framer Motion animations: fade-in on scroll for sections, stagger animations for card grids, smooth page transitions, hover effects on cards and buttons
Create apps/web/src/app/globals.css with TailwindCSS custom theme extensions, custom component styles, smooth scrolling, and dark mode CSS variables

Add mock data in apps/web/src/lib/mock-data.ts with realistic Indonesian vehicle data (Toyota Avanza, Honda Brio, Daihatsu Sigra, electric motorcycles like Alva One, Gesits), pricing in IDR, and testimonials
acceptance_criteria: pnpm run build succeeds for apps/web without errors
All public pages render with proper layout (header + content + footer)
Landing page has all required sections with animations
Fleet listing shows vehicle cards with working filters and pagination
Fleet detail page shows complete vehicle information
All pages have proper metadata for SEO
Mobile responsive design works at 375px, 768px, and 1024px widths
WhatsApp floating button is visible on all pages
No TypeScript errors in strict mode
findings: Build passes cleanly with zero warnings. All 26 pages generated statically (SSG). Used Inter font from next/font/google. Framer Motion animations work with 'use client' directive. Used custom collapsible FAQ (accordion) with useState rather than shadcn Accordion since it was not installed. Contact and Partnership pages use react-hook-form with zod validation. Fleet detail uses Next.js 15 async params pattern (Promise<{ id: string }>). No Sheet component available so mobile nav uses simple animated div.
